description: Canonical column order for the Phase-2/3 benchmark harness (PROTOCOL.md sections 4, 5, 6, 1.3, 7, 8.2). Julia (code/julia/harness.jl) and Python (code/python/harness.py) both read this file and emit rows in exactly this order, so bench_spd.csv and bench_drazin.csv concatenate across languages. One row = one timed repetition of one experimental unit (language, regime, method, family, instance, rep). Version 2 (Phase 3) appends the four precond_* columns (PROTOCOL.md section 7): preconditioner identity (never aliased), fill factor, Manteuffel diagonal shift, and unshifted-IC(0) breakdown flag. CSVs written under schema_version 1 are NOT column-compatible and must be regenerated with run_benchmarks.py --fresh.
